svg.title: Projects. Before moving into cognitive science I worked in data analytics at Bosch and completed the NextLeap product fellowship, which trained me in hypothesis driven user research and measurement. Research: The Song or the Self (preregistered EEG study of music and emotion); Study Hub (study dashboard for cognitive science). Job search tools: Recruiter Info (validates every posting first); Claude job plugin (job discovery and tracking inside Claude). Portfolio: the portfolio site. AI assistants: Blinkit Intent to Basket (say the outcome, get the basket); Shopping AI Assistant (cart aware grocery picks with reasons); Mutual fund FAQ assistant (facts only answers with a source link); Wealth Monitor (AI personal finance coach for Indian users); AI Discovery Engine (themes across large sets of app reviews). Product thinking: Prioritization, Metrics and Growth (why urban Indian users avoid voice input); Engati pitch (business case proved against six KPIs by day 180); Eureka teardown (growth by removing the language barrier); n8n teardown (blank canvas paralysis in onboarding); Nykaa Fit (size recommendation experiment with an A/B test). Links are listed below this image.
